messages:
elaine: heads-up — deploying model-routing-v2 during the 17:00-18:00 UTC change window. planning a canary + staged ramp. needs quick sync on FF percentages and rollback criteria.
deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed. rolling out to canary tier (will wait for manual FF enable). build: sha@b3f7a2
sam: propose: start at 1% (canary), wait 10m, then 5% -> 20% -> 50% over 3 hours if metrics look good.
noah: +1 but add region gating: EU start at 0.5% then mirror US after first checkpoint. last time EU latencies spiked.
maria: rollback criteria: error rate >1.5% OR p95 latency increase >200ms from baseline for 2 consecutive checkpoints (10m each). also regression in token-cost by >8%? flag it.
tyler: command to enable canary: `rcli feature-flag set model-routing-v2 canary=1% --reason "17:00 window"` then `rcli ff inc model-routing-v2 5%` etc. (ops has runbook).
devops-bot: note: autoscaler configured with scale-delay=120s. if we see queue growth >50% in canary, hold ramp and alert #eng-oncall.
jo: suggest also pinning older model variant for heavy cohorts: `router pin cohort=enterprise model=stable-v3` so enterprise traffic stays stable.
elaine: agree on pin for enterprise and partners. sam can you own progressive increments and post checkpoints? will monitor release-notes link after deploy.
sam: taking ownership. checkpoint cadence: 10m after 1%, then 20m after 5%, then hourly. I'll post status in this thread.
noah: also add a fast rollback command in the runbook: `rcli feature-flag set model-routing-v2 0% --emergency` and `router unpin cohort=all model=stable-v3` — tested these in staging.
maria: can we add a canary-specific logging flag so we can trace any misrouted spans quickly? `LOG_CANARY=1` in env for canary nodes.
alex: FYI release-notes draft: "model-routing-v2: intelligent routing, latency optimizations; opt-in via FF; rollout controlled" — I'll push to docs once deploy is green.
elaine: tiny ask: tag the deploy with `change-ticket: CHG-1124` in the ticket system when you enable canary. ops needs that for audit.
sam: done — ticket tagged at enable.
deploy-bot: deploy event: canary enable requested by sam at 2145678920. waiting for manual toggle.
sam: toggled to 1% now. monitoring logs and metrics.
devops-bot: metric alert rule subscribed: routing-error-rate, p95-latency, queue-depth. will notify if thresholds hit.
sam: 10m checkpoint — p95 +10ms, error rate unchanged, token-cost +1%. moving to 5%.
elain (typo fix): elaine: small correction — spelled my name wrong earlier :P
maria: after 5% ramp: p95 +30ms, error rate 0.9% — within bounds. keep going to 20% but hold if token-cost crosses +6%.
sam: moving to 20% now. posting progress.
jo: earlier pinning command executed for enterprise cohorts. confirmed.
noah: reminder: if EU spikes, revert EU flag only (we can set region-scoped FF). use `rcli ff set model-routing-v2 eu=0%`
tyler: can we publish a short blurb to #customer-facing-release that this is a controlled canary and partners may see minor routing changes? alex please queue.
alex: queued draft to #customer-facing-release, will hold until 50% step completes.
sam: 3h total into window — at 50% now. metrics hold steady.
maria: holding final ramp to 100% until tomorrow morning's low-traffic window. recommend full rollout in 24h to let long-tail metrics settle.
elaine: approved. leaving 50% overnight. if anything abnormal overnight, oncall escalate. otherwise full rollout tomorrow 08:00 UTC with final FF to 100%.
sam: logging final notes: canary ran 12h with stable metrics. no emergency rollbacks needed. will post final release-note link after morning cutover. :tada:
